'''Nossit Cicer''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as [[major]] in the [[Resistance]] during their [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[First Order]]. During the [[Battle of Oetchi|attack]] on the [[Resistance navy|Resistance fleet]] by the First Order following the [[Battle of D'Qar|evacuation]] from the [[planet]] [[D'Qar]]<ref name="TLJVD" /> in the [[Standard year|year]] [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the events of the film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] in [[34 ABY]]. As [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']] carries on immediately from the events of ''The Force Awakens'', it can be assumed to take place in the same [[Standard year|year]].</ref> he served under [[Vice Admiral]] [[Amilyn Holdo]] on the [[Free Virgillia-class Bunkerbuster|''Free Virgillia''-class Bunkerbuster]] ''[[Ninka]]''. When the primary [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] of the [[MC85 Star Cruiser]] [[Raddus (MC85 Star Cruiser)|''Raddus'']] was destroyed, [[Death|killing]] almost all of [[Resistance High Command]] and injuring [[General]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], Cicer joined Holdo and several other officers loyal to her in transferring to the ''Raddus'' so that the vice [[admiral]] could take command of the fleet as the highest ranking officer still able to command.

When all remaining Resistance personnel were ordered onto [[Resistance transport]]s, Cicer boarded one which contained [[Poe Dameron]] and [[C-3PO]].<ref name="ICS">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> When the [[First Order]] launched a bombardment on the fleet, many transports were destroyed. Cicer's transport survived the attack, and the ship arrived safely on [[Crait]]. The [[Battle of Crait]] quickly ensued, and the Resistance escaped, though not before sustaining many casualties.

Cicer wore a [[Color|brown]] [[brismoss-fiber]] [[Clothing|uniform]] tunic with dark brown pants, brown [[boot]]s, and a [[belt]] where he holstered a [[Glie-44 blaster pistol]]. Cicer's skin was fair in color and his [[hair]] was brown and gray.<ref name="TLJVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nossit Cicer was portrayed by [[Tim Steed]] in the film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']],<ref name="TLJ">{{Film|VIII}}</ref> which was released on [[December 15]], [[2017]].<ref name="Release Date">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-episode-viii-to-open-december-15-2017|text=''Star Wars: Episode VIII'' to Open December 15, 2017}}</ref> Steed was credited only as "Amilyn Holdo's officer" in the film,<ref name="TLJ" /> but received a name in ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="TLJVD" /> and released in conjunction with the film.<ref name="Release date">{{SW|url=news/new-star-wars-the-last-jedi-books-and-more-revealed-at-sdcc-2017|text=New ''Star Wars: The Last Jedi'' Books and More Revealed at SDCC 2017}}</ref>
